scope: Structural and MAC census for safe provisioning/idempotence only. This does not approve a grant graph or domain phase; those require the later Owner/phase eligibility implementation and ordinary current authority.

root.precursor_only: only admission.sqlite; no approvals without whole valid issuer

approvals.children: 64 lowercase hexadecimal directory names; each0700, canonical owned nonsymlink; a present child requires approval.json

files.name: grant-NNNNNN.json
files.sequence: Exact six digits matching record.sequence, integer2..999999; initial sequence1 uses approval.json

files.name: intent-0P.json
files.phase: P exactly1..4; filename matches signed record.phase01..04

files.name: phase-0P.json
files.phase: P exactly1..4; filename matches signed record.phase01..04

file_requirements: Every file regular, single-linked, effective-UID-owned,0600 from creation; bounded nofollow descriptor read with before/after descriptor/path identity. Canonical whole signed codec bytes, valid MAC under actual admitted issuer key, matching repository/worktree/approval directory ID and exact whole issuer SHA. Unknown/staged/quarantine names refuse and survive; no cleanup inferred from name.
idempotence: Valid whole issuer may coexist with this authenticated closed census. Bootstrap reports only original issuer identity and confers no approval/phase authority; malformed/partial/foreign state refuses without rewriting it. Directory identities and sorted entry lists are reread after census.

resumed_seed_plan.same_live_flow: The actual confirmed seed READY plan_sha256 is retained privately and signed as issuer.seed_plan_sha256.
resumed_seed_plan.precursor_only_new_process: No original first-review absence witness or token is persisted by the fixed-seed-only protocol. Use SHA256(JCS({kind:'reconciliation-seed-resume',host_identity:actual_identity,binding_sha256:actual_current_B5_digest,namespace_sha256:actual_precursor_witness_digest,seed_sha256:fixed_seed_digest})). This names the exact current validation plan, never a fabricated historical first review. The second READY artifact SHA binds this resumed plan and full actual anchor.
resumed_seed_plan.effect: Second confirmation explicitly includes sync-precursor before native admission, then frozen issuer publication. The raw seed descriptor is closed before the native connection opens; no anchor descriptor is opened/closed inside its callback.
